# RallyUp

> > RallyUp is a comprehensive online fundraising platform enabling nonprofits and organizations to run raffles, auctions, sweepstakes, crowdfunding campaigns, and ticketed events with professional results.

RallyUp provides an integrated suite of fundraising tools designed for nonprofits, schools, and charitable organizations. The platform combines multiple fundraising methods—from silent and live auctions to peer-to-peer campaigns and event management—with features like QR code check-in, mobile bidding, CRM integrations, and done-for-you services.

## Key Topics

- Raffles
- Auctions (Silent & Live)
- Crowdfunding
- Peer-to-Peer Fundraising
- Sweepstakes

## Auction & Bidding Solutions

- [Free Online Fundraising Auction Tool for Nonprofits - RallyUp](https://rallyup.com/auctions): RallyUp online auction tool with English-style bidding and proxy options.
- [Silent Auctions: A Unique Fundraising Approach - RallyUp](https://rallyup.com/silent-auctions): RallyUp silent auction management with QR codes and mobile bidding.
- [Live Auctions: How to Maximize Your Fundraising - RallyUp](https://rallyup.com/live-auctions): RallyUp live auction software with hybrid bidding and donor engagement.
- [Paddle Raise+ - RallyUp](https://rallyup.com/paddle-raise): RallyUp Paddle Raise+ for in-person fundraising and live event bidding.

## Raffle, Sweepstakes & Ticketing

- [Free Online Raffle and Fundraising Platform - Sell Raffle Tickets Online with RallyUp](https://rallyup.com/raffles): RallyUp raffle platform with 50/50 raffle and ticket sales features.
- [Unlock Fundraising Success with Our Thrilling Sweepstakes](https://rallyup.com/sweepstakes): RallyUp sweepstakes platform for engaging online contests and giveaways.
- [Online Ticketing Solutions for Fundraising - RallyUp](https://rallyup.com/ticketing): RallyUp online ticketing with event management and QR code check-in.
